clips.title: The story
paras: Return to Quinn is a Horde quest in Silverpine Forest where an adventurer delivers a restorative draught concocted by Apothecary Renferrel to the wounded Deathstalker Quinn Yorick. Trapped and weakened at the Ivar Patch north of the Sepulcher, Quinn requires the draught before he can contemplate returning to duty.

Following the harvesting of wild beast hearts for the Royal Apothecary Society, Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher brews a restorative potion formulated to aid Quinn Yorick. Renferrel has little time for sentimentality or bedside manners, quickly handing off the mixture to return to his own clandestine alchemical research, leaving the adventurer to run the courier run back into the wilderness.

Quinn Yorick hides beside his sister, Deathstalker Rane Yorick, amid the ruined farmstead known as the Ivar Patch. Severely hurt by the ghoul Ivar the Foul and unable to march through hostile territory, Quinn drinks the draught immediately upon arrival. While the concoction restores his strength enough to eventually travel, the surrounding territory remains fraught with danger, particularly under the watchful malice of the ghoul lurking nearby.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.
Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...

clips.title: Progress
paras: My sister told me you were here to aid us. Is that true?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel.
You have done me a great favor, friend.
